input.body:
Please consider the following file:

```python
Type: object
def foo(x: Type) -> None: ...
```

When checking it with '2.1.1 Python 3.8.0 on Linux' (or Python 3.7.3) I get the following error:

```
foo.py:2: undefined name 'Type'
```

This is problematic when checking python stub files.
input.title: Undefined name when using variable annotations
